annotations.text:
Main direction: instrument panel. Warm dark neutrals, amber = RF/authorization, red only for STOP and LIVE, teal for OK. Space Grotesk + JetBrains Mono for every number.

Mode tabs replace the <select>; the ON AIR card puts frequency, countdown and STOP first. Everything shown maps to existing fields in tx/modes.py.

B and C below are low-fi alternates if you'd rather go another way.
